procedure_text:
The form in question or mixtures of different forms of tembotrione were suspended in a mixture of methanol with water (volume ratio methanol:water 1:9) at temperatures in the range from 10 to 30° C., and the temperature varied cyclically at a rate of 0.33 K min^-1.
After 2 days under these conditions, a mixture of forms A, B and C had converted into form A.
procedure_summary: A mixture of all three crystalline forms of tembotrione, suspended in aqueous methanol while the temperature is cycled over a narrow range, converts into form A after some days.
